projects.title: Taniin Play to Earn
projects.desc: A Web3 farming game prototype built with Flutter and Flame, featuring land ownership, crop economy, wallet sync, and Sepolia integration.
projects.fullDesc:
Taniin is a landscape farming game prototype for Android and Web built with Flutter and Flame. Players can buy land, purchase seeds, plant crops, harvest, sell items, and keep their game progress locally.

The project includes Web3 integration on Sepolia with wallet sync, ERC-20 TANI balance reading, transaction history, backend signer actions, and Solidity contracts for land, items, and token rewards.

projects.title: App Absensi SDN 1 Bintaro
projects.desc: A school attendance management system for SDN 1 Bintaro with student data, daily attendance tracking, and admin-friendly reporting.
projects.fullDesc: App Absensi SDN 1 Bintaro is a web-based attendance management system built to help school staff record, manage, and monitor student attendance more efficiently. The application focuses on clean data input, organized student records, class-based attendance tracking, and a simple dashboard flow for daily school operations.
